fold_source: data/qmutbench_ml/exhaustive_campaign_v1/five_fold_confirmation/mutation_diff_oof.npz numeric record_id/y/fold arrays; origin_program verified by joining development OOF CSV; object array is never unpickled

sampling.method: deterministic per-origin/per-class caps then per-class caps
sampling.note: sampled development OOF only; QNN and classical controls share the exact eligible fold samples; no full-corpus training or full-heldout-fold score

preprocessing.encoder: ReducedFeatureEncoder; train-fold-only one-hot/min-max, mutual-information top-k then min-max [0,1]

qnn.architecture: angle re-uploading VQC, Rot layers, ring CNOT, trainable affine sigmoid readout
qnn.gradient: PennyLane autograd backprop; one-parameter centered finite-difference check each fold

memory.estimate: 1 GiB safety floor + 700 MiB runtime/source-join reserve + sampled dense arrays + config-dependent complex128 statevector/autodiff-tape estimate
memory.notes: preflight runs before scientific imports; available RAM is checked after loading, before each fit, and for every QNN minibatch

checkpointing.stale_or_corrupt: reject; never overwrite existing non-checkpoint outputs
